classes.name: stop
classes.description: Executes immediate complete halt at line; holds active brake until path is clear.

classes.name: no_entry
classes.description: Prohibited roadway; halts forward motion, warns control room, initiates reverse maneuver.

classes.name: speed_limit_30
classes.description: Limits maximum vehicle throttle/speed to 30% duty cycle for compliance with 30 km/h zone.

classes.name: school_ahead
classes.description: Approaching school zone; decelerates vehicle to 25%, activates blue caution flasher.

classes.name: pedestrian_crossing
classes.description: Pedestrian crossing ahead; slows to 20%, prepares to brake if ToF detects obstacle.

classes.name: slippery_road
classes.description: Reduced surface friction; reduces acceleration jerk, limits torque and caps duty to 20%.

classes.name: right_hand_curve
classes.description: Sharp right bend ahead; activates differential tank drive steering bias (Left: 35%, Right: 15%).

classes.name: give_way
classes.description: Yield right of way; slows to 15%, scans intersection with ToF sensor for 2 seconds before proceeding.

classes.name: no_parking
classes.description: No stopping zone; prohibits vehicle idle stop when roadway is clear, maintains continuous cruising.

classes.name: narrow_road_ahead
classes.description: Roadway narrows; reduces speed to 25% duty, centers vehicle heading to prevent side scraping.
